prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election — this is the call of the one panel astrologer singled out on the card. Specifics: the panellist who, when 17 Republicans still contested the nomination, had already picked Trump to become the Republican nominee follows the same judgement through to the general election: Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016, against the polling lead and against the panel majority. Timing: single-date event, 8 November 2016 (day-scale per the question). Confidence mid-range: the basis is this astrologer's demonstrated nominee call on the card plus the same anti-establishment signature, not a supplied chart; the prediction deliberately does not average this call with the WP-004 consensus.
basis:
